The '''sensorlink network system''' was equipped on [[850.AA Public Service Headquarters]]. It continually scanned the streets and public facilities and documented anything that was dirty, broken, or not up to code for the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to fix.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
